mechanism: SQLAlchemy 1.4 rejects Cinder's relationship joined-load option after its resource-count query has been converted to expression-only entities
repair_template: disable relationship eager-loading for aggregate queries that replace mapped entities with scalar expressions

replay.failure_signature: sqlalchemy.exc.ArgumentError: Query has only expression-based entities - can't find property named "volume_metadata".

semantic_review.a1_failure: On the unchanged Cinder opening-cutoff snapshot, all six parameterized forms of the pre-existing volume-list count test pass with SQLAlchemy 1.3.23. With 1.4.11, all six fail with the same exclusive ArgumentError because the expression-only count query still carries the volume_metadata joined-load option; the maintainer repair restores all six.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Reviewed the one-pin source opening diff, the one-file production maintainer change rebased without semantic alteration onto the opening-cutoff snapshot, the cutoff tox command, installed-version probes proving SQLAlchemy 1.3.23/1.4.11/1.4.11, patch applicability, and complete three-arm logs. The same six pre-existing DDT-generated tests run in every arm; only A1 has the normalized expression-entity ArgumentError. The Python 3.8/tox 3/virtualenv 20 runner, source-era setuptools seed, Cython build constraint, and pip seed are identical across arms and only restore opening-era packaging compatibility.
semantic_review.source_effect: The source opening changes exactly one upper-constraints pin, SQLAlchemy 1.3.23 to 1.4.11; SQLAlchemy 1.4 no longer accepts a relationship loader option on a query whose mapped entity has been replaced by aggregate expressions.
semantic_review.target_repair: The maintainer change applies to the public opening-cutoff Cinder snapshot and suppresses joined loading only for calculate_resource_count while preserving it for normal snapshot and backup retrieval. It changes one production database module and changes, deletes, or skips no test.
